subject: Nexoria renewal — request for executive safeguard approval
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Nexoria renewal — request for executive safeguard approval

Team,

Nexoria (ARR $1.2M) is at the renewal decision point. They asked for a last-minute commercial concession after procurement pushed their renewal through a consolidated quarter-close. Key ask from the customer and PO:

- 30% list discount on base seats for 12 months (applied to the upcoming annual invoice)
- A one-time platform credit of $75k for migration/quality uplift work
- Reset the start date to 2027-01-01 (term shift) to align with their fiscal year
- SLA additive: 20% uptime credit monthly for any single-month outage >3 hours in the first 12 months

Rationale: They state they have a consolidated procurement window and can commit to a 24-month contract if we put the above in place. They are asking for the discount to be ratified by leadership. Procurement (external) is pushing for a single signature by 10/29 to meet their internal PO cycle.

Commercials snapshot (proposal):
- Current ARR: $1,200,000
- Proposed first-year true-up after discount: $840,000 (30% off)
- One-time credit: $75,000 applied against first invoice
- Committed term: 24 months (auto-renew thereafter)

My recommendation: approve a one-time concession package limited to Q4 close only if we get a signed 24-month commitment, include a clause that the SLA credit is capped at 3 months of invoice value lifetime, and require use of Redwood Optimize for quantization recommendations (to reduce token cost) to avoid future margin erosion.

Attachments: Nexoria_MA_plans_v3.pdf (pricing), Nexoria_renewal_RMP.xlsx (math), Signed-SOW-draft.docx (term template).

Requesting expedited review: can Deal Desk + Finance + Revenue leadership sign off by end of day 10/26? If not, I will ask for a 1:1 with revenue leadership to expedite.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexoria renewal — request for executive safeguard approval

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. A couple of immediate flags from a finance/contracting perspective:

1) 30% discount on base seats for a $1.2M ACV is material and exceeds our standard authority limits for the sales organization. We need explicit exec approval.
2) The one-time $75k credit could be restructured as implementation professional services credit rather than a cash credit — that preserves margin if we can bundle PM hours.
3) SLA credit language as written is risky — "20% uptime credit monthly for any single-month outage >3 hours" is open to interpretation and could be costly. Recommend a cap that ties credits to MTTR thresholds and a dollar cap per incident.
4) Resetting the start date to 2027-01-01 is operationally fine but we should require that billing proration and a signed amendment be executed before the new term starts.

I will run preliminary P&L impact models and attach a revised RMP with scenarios showing net revenue over 24 months with/without credits. If revenue leadership approves, I'll work with Legal to draft limit language for the SLA credit and change the $75k to a statement-of-work credit obligation.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Finance — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Amy Chen <amy.chen@nexoria.com>, David Lin <david.lin@procureco.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nexoria renewal — request for executive safeguard approval

Vivek / Marissa — looping you in for executive signoff. Procurement is asking for final confirmation by end-of-week. I’m proposing the following narrowed concession package to preserve economics while keeping the deal: 

- Commercial concession: 20% off base seats year 1 (instead of 30%) if Nexoria signs a 24-month commitment today.
- One-time implementation credit re-scoped to $50k of pre-paid PS (applies only to onboarding + migration milestones).
- SLA amendment: define outage credit as a tiered schedule capped at 3% of annual invoice per incident; credit applies only if MTTR > 4 hours and after a technical postmortem.
- Term reset: new term start 2027-01-01 with signed amendment and pro-rated billing for the 2027 first invoice.

Why this is reasonable:
- Preserves $240k of ARR in year one vs. the 30% ask, but still gives Nexoria a meaningful concession to close now.
- Converts hard cash credit into PS credit where possible (protects margin).
- Caps SLA exposure and ties it to MTTR and postmortem acceptance.

Customer note (Amy Chen): "If Redwood can meet the 20% + $50k onboarding credit and the start-date reset, procurement will expedite signatures and issue PO this week."

Request: Can you approve the above as an executive safeguard for this quarter close? If yes, Legal will prepare an amendment and I will coordinate the SOW/PS schedule.

Forwarded attachment: Nexoria_renewal_RMP.xlsx

— Karthik

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy.chen@nexoria.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexoria renewal — request for executive safeguard approval

Karthik / team — after reviewing the numbers and risk mitigations, I approve the narrowed concession package as an executive safeguard for this Q4 close with the conditions below: 

1) 20% off base seats in year 1 only, contingent on a signed 24-month commitment and PO receipt by 2026-10-29 23:59 PT.
2) $50k of onboarding PS credit to be delivered as pre-paid, invoiced, and applied against SOW milestones; cannot be converted to cash.
3) SLA amendment to use the tiered credit schedule:
   - Incident MTTR 4–12 hours: 1% monthly invoice credit (capped at $25k per incident)
   - Incident MTTR >12 hours: 3% monthly invoice credit (capped at $75k per incident)
   - Credit requires internal postmortem and customer acceptance; maximum aggregate SLA credit in first 12 months: 3 months of invoice value.
4) Legal to draft amendment with an explicit clause that any further concession requests will revert to the standard renewal review process (no precedent set).

Marissa — please confirm Legal lead and timeline to issue an amendment and return the redlines to Karthik by EOD 10/27 so procurement can proceed. Neha — finalize the P&L with the approved structure and attach to the amendment.

Amy — I appreciate the quick work from Nexoria procurement. Once PO is in hand and amendment signed we will lock pricing and schedule onboarding.

Vivek Kulkarni
SVP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
